items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: And I joined his band in Cuckoo's place.

items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: Playing with Arnold DePass, he's not deceased. He was an old time drummer too, an old drummer.

ctx.x: Do you remember your very first job that you played on the trumpet?
Playing with Arnold DePass, he's not deceased. He was an old time drummer too, an old drummer.
